value: | Recording flag | Durable preference `track_recording_enabled` is intent, not proof of an active service or track row. The menu and the walking-person button under the ruler distinguish Start, Starting, Recording and Error; neither shows a false active state before service confirmation. Map/menu/notification request confirmation before Stop; Cancel/Back leave intent untouched. A durable recording-session UUID rejects stale dialogs/notifications and survives recovery/split. Confirmed Stop persists pending_stop and clears recording intent only after all queued points and track closure are committed. A foreground/SQLite failure keeps the queue and warns without deleting unfinished data. |
